title: Use an existing hollow
hook: Where do these socks add less outer volume?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: The shoe envelope already contains a hollow. Filling that empty region with compatible soft socks can use space that would otherwise remain empty instead of adding another outside bundle.

recall.question: A shoe has a 500 cm³ hollow inside its outline. You have 300 cm³ of rolled socks. In the ideal model, how much outer volume do they add if packed inside it?
recall.why: In the ideal hollow model, socks that fit within the existing hollow add max(0, 300 − 500) = 0 cm³ outside. Packed beside the shoe they add all 300 cm³. Use clean, dry items and do not force the shoe.
